## Change

Describe the case or implementation change and link the issue.

## Evidence

State source provenance, checks performed, and unresolved items.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the case and task contracts.
- [ ] Source/registry changes pass `python tools/verify_sources.py`, or this PR changes neither.
- [ ] Geometry and scoring claims are limited to checks actually completed.
- [ ] Model input remains separated from GT construction sources.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO sign-off.
